note: Hand verified spec corrections, keyed by VIN, applied LAST by operations/build_vehicles_json.py (after the hub DB build sheet, the DealerCenter ad copy and the NHTSA vPIC decode). Use it for what no automatic source gets right: horsepower vPIC does not return, a trim DealerCenter wrote with a body word in it, a one time slug repair. Keys per VIN: engine, drivetrain (AWD|4WD|FWD|RWD), trim, bodyStyle, fuelType, slug, note. A slug change retires the old URL with a 301 to the new VDP (build-inventory.js keeps that ledger). Remove an entry once the unit is sold; a stale entry is harmless but noisy. Started 2026-10-11 after the engine and AWD audit.
